"""A compliant adapter: FlowAdapter implements FlowRepository, so every one of its public
methods matches a port method name -- adapter_methods_without_port must not report it. The port
import is relative (three dots, app.infrastructure.kissflow -> app), proving the scan resolves a
relative import to its port module, not just an absolute one."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from ...application.interfaces.flow import FlowRepository


class FlowAdapter(FlowRepository):
    """Implements FlowRepository against an in-memory store, for the fixture only."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._store: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def get_draft(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Matches the port method get_draft."""
        return self._store.get(flow_id, {})

    def publish(self, flow_id: str) -> None:
        """Matches the port method publish."""
        self._store.pop(flow_id, None)
